description: Find where something is said across saved video transcripts, instead of reading whole transcripts (about 12k tokens per hour). Hybrid search: keyword matching for exact names and model numbers, plus meaning-based matching for paraphrases (when an embedding model is available). Returns the best time ranges with title, [m:ss], highlighted text and a timestamp link. Syntax: "exact phrase" must appear, -word excludes. Scope with collection (a collection id) or urls (videos are fetched and saved first if needed).

query.description: What to look for. "quoted phrases" are required, -word excludes a word

rerank.description: Rerank the top results with a free LLM. Slower; default false

name: search_transcript
title: Search transcripts
